messages:
lia: Quick sync — integrator track planning. We have 3 demo pods (A/B/C), 20-min slots, 45-min speaker blocks for panels. Need: speaker->demo pod matching, AV reqs, and swag kit owners. Can folks confirm by EOD?
casey: Taking Pod A (latency/cost demo) — speaker = Casey R., will need 1 mic + HDMI. Also request local network mirror for on-prem demo.
jamal: I'll take Pod B (SI integration flow) — speaker Jamal K. Need 2 mics (panel + demo), ethernet, and a laptop with GPU passthrough testing.
marco: Pod C for HW partner live run. Speaker Marco T. AV: HDMI, power strip, and we'll bring a USB capture device. Demo fallback = pre-recorded video if HW flaky.
elaine: For speaker matching — panelists for the 45-min block should be Casey, Jamal, Marco, + Sarah from Events for customer ops perspective. Elaine will moderate.
sarah (events): @elaine added — swag plan: two tiers — VIP (partner-branded jacket + sticker pack) and general (sticker + seed notebook). Need final counts by Tue. Courier ETA Wed noon.
lia: Thanks. @sarah can you confirm courier carrier and tracking? Also who owns packing list?
sarah (events): I'll own packing list. Draft inventory below: 
```
- 60 VIP jackets
- 200 sticker packs
- 150 seed notebooks
- 30 demo dongles (backup)
```
lia: Perfect. @casey @jamal @marco, please confirm any additional consumables (USB-C hubs, adapters) by EOD.
casey: Need 3x USB-C hubs and 2x M.2 power cables.
jamal: I'll need an extra test SIM for network failover + 1x 10Gb switch for bench testing.
marco: Bring 2x spare SSDs and one 1U fan.
ops-bot: Reminder: submit AV form by 3524690000 to secure tech support. Link: https://events.internal/av-request
lia: AV form submitted (lia). Also setting up a shared runbook — will drop link in here tomorrow.
elaine: For backups: plan to have a pre-recorded 15-min clip per demo uploaded to s3 + local USB copy. That should cover HW flakiness.
casey: Agree. I'll produce a 10-min condensed screencast for Pod A as well.
jamal: Can we have a quick dry-run Tue 16:00 PT? 30 mins to check routing + network.
sarah (events): Dry-run scheduled. Courier picking up swag Mon 09:00 PT. I'll share tracking once booked.
lia: Great. Final checklist to close this thread: speaker slides, 15-min pre-record, AV form, swag counts, packing owner (sarah). If anyone hits blockers ping me. :thumbsup:
